newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singmarine wins S$12 mln barge order.
newsitem.headline: Singmarine wins S$12 mln barge order.

text.p: Shipbuilder Singmarine Industries Ltd said on Monday it had landed a Singapore $12.0 million contract to build a self-unloading barge for an Indonesian mining client.
Singmarine, a Keppel Corp unit, said in a statement work on the 15,000 dwt tonnes barge for PT Freeport was expected to be completed in the second quarter of 1998.
Singmarine said the PT Freeport order was repeat business and that work on a previously ordered barge and two tug boats was progressing.
